name: Amphetamine
author: Chase Cargill
description: Amphetamine for Omarchy: keep the system awake with the laptop lid closed, and power the internal display down while it is shut.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and a macOS-style dropdown: pick a keep-awake duration, and choose what happens to the screen when the lid closes.

schema.label: Show remaining time in the bar
schema.description: Draw the countdown next to the icon while a timed session is running.
